I will keep it simple and steady this year. I am in Quzhou County on the North China Plain, so the crop pattern I trust most is still winter wheat followed by summer maize on the same land. At my age, I do not want to spread myself across too many crops or chase high-risk cash crops that need more labor, more market judgment, and tighter management. Wheat and maize fit the local weather, the local water and machinery conditions, and the way people farm here. I can use improved wheat seed and hybrid maize seed, keep fertilizer in a moderate range, irrigate only at the key stages, and rely on a few timely pesticide sprays instead of many. I would rather aim for stable grain yield, lower hassle, and work I can finish on time than make the year too complicated.
